name: Playwright Game Tester
description: GENEX-owned, localhost-first MCP bridge to an existing locally installed Microsoft Playwright MCP executable. No auto-download.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Inspect configured upstream entry path and SHA-256 lock. Does not start a browser or prove the MCP server is ready.

tools.name: probe
tools.description: Launch the exact SHA-256-reviewed upstream through the existing MCP proxy, complete a bounded MCP initialize/tools-list handshake, and report actual discovered tool availability. No website navigation; not gameplay proof.
tools.confirmation: Start the locally configured upstream MCP server for a 12-second handshake check? This executes trusted local Node code and may start a browser service.

skills.name: browser-game-testing
skills.summary: Use the Playwright MCP connector to test a locally hosted game; read for setup, permitted tools, localhost boundaries and evidence limitations.

settings.label: Absolute @playwright/mcp cli.js or reviewed playwright-mcp alias
Reviewed upstream entry script SHA-256 (64 hex characters)
Exact local game origin (scheme, host, port)
Enable 3D canvas pointer input (opt-in; requires official Playwright MCP vision tools)

actions.name: probe
actions.label: Test MCP connection
actions.confirmation: Start the locally configured Playwright MCP server to test its protocol and tools? It executes native local code.

mcpServers.description: Launches the reviewed local Playwright MCP in a temporary, isolated headless profile. Enables safe DOM inspection, form/drag/hover QA; coordinate-based game canvas mouse input is opt-in and requires Playwright MCP vision capability. No auto-install. Only direct navigations are origin checked; page links, redirects and resource requests are not a network sandbox. SHA-256 verifies the entry script only, not transitive npm dependencies.
